# TASK-158 — specification

## Scope

Tasks appear when the specification is correct: approving a baseline (which already requires full readiness) creates or refreshes the board from the task plan, never deleting a card, and says how many tasks it created; a board conflict never blocks the approval. The Board's refresh action uses the same plan.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Baseline approval calls the same function and merges the result into the board without deleting anything.
- [x] A board that changed at the same moment (revision conflict) is retried once; if it still conflicts the approval stands and the Board's refresh action is the way to catch up.
